targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM max(time)) * 1000 AS "Value" FROM garmin."DeviceSync"

panels.title: Last Sync
panels.description: The time of the newest heart rate sample. It ignores the time range.
Average over the complete days in the time range. Today counts after it ends.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg("restingHeartRate") AS "Value"
FROM garmin."DailyStats" WHERE time >= (date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND time < (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})

panels.title: Heart Rate
panels.description: Blue is below 60 bpm, green is 60 to 96, yellow is 96 to 110, and red is above 110, as in the distribution.

targets.rawSql: SELECT mean_value AS "Heart rate histogram" FROM (SELECT avg("HeartRate") AS mean_value FROM garmin."HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time_bucket(interval '1 minute', time)) AS samples WHERE mean_value <= 96

SELECT mean_value AS "Heart rate histogram > 96" FROM (SELECT avg("HeartRate") AS mean_value FROM garmin."HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time_bucket(interval '1 minute', time)) AS samples WHERE mean_value > 96

SELECT mean_value AS "Heart rate histogram < 60" FROM (SELECT avg("HeartRate") AS mean_value FROM garmin."HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time_bucket(interval '1 minute', time)) AS samples WHERE mean_value < 60

SELECT mean_value AS "Heart rate histogram > 110" FROM (SELECT avg("HeartRate") AS mean_value FROM garmin."HeartRateIntraday" WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time_bucket(interval '1 minute', time)) AS samples WHERE mean_value > 110
